name: Verona
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Verona, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Verona, WI for 2026: Hometown Holidays, Santa's Workshop and Christkindlmarket, with dates and costs checked on host sites.
lede: Verona starts its holidays on the first Friday of December with a tree lighting in Century School Park, then keeps going with live reindeer, Santa and a European style Christkindlmarket.
celebrates: Verona kicks off the season with the Verona Area Chamber of Commerce's Hometown Holiday Kick-Off on the first Friday of December. Century School Park hosts the tree lighting, with ice skating, hot cider and cocoa, fire pits, caroling and rides on the Holiday Express Trolley. A short trolley ride away, the Verona Senior Center serves a chili supper cooked by the Verona Fire Department, with Santa visits, cookie decorating, crafts with the Verona Public Library and a scavenger hunt. The chamber follows with Santa's Workshop the next day, and local groups add a Breakfast with Santa and holiday concerts through December.
lastyear: In 2025 the Hometown Holiday Kick-Off ran Friday, December 5, from 4 to 7 pm at Century School Park and the Verona Senior Center, with the tree lighting at 5 pm and caroling by Resurrection Lutheran Church. The next afternoon, families visited Santa's reindeer at Sugar Creek Elementary School from 3 to 5 pm, with performances by the Verona Area Community Theater and craft stations run by local groups. The Christkindlmarket that year was held at Seven Acre Dairy in nearby Paoli.
facts: Verona's tree lighting takes place on the first Friday of December each year, according to WMTV. In 2024 it moved into the brand new Century School Park, and Santa arrived by fire truck to light the tree. The senior center's annual chili supper is a fundraiser for the Badger Prairie Needs Network, the local food pantry. The chamber's reindeer afternoon, once called Reindeer Live, now goes by Santa's Workshop. The Christkindlmarket began in Paoli in December 2023 and moved to Verona for 2026.
trains: Verona does not have a holiday train ride of its own. Its Holiday Express is a trolley that circles town and shuttles guests between Century School Park and the senior center on tree lighting night. For real rails, families drive west of Madison to the Mid-Continent Railway Museum in North Freedom, which runs Santa Express weekends in the season. Check that museum's page for dates and ticket details before you go.
train_links: Seven-mile steam and diesel train rides at North Freedom, with Santa Express weekends in the season.
traditions: The chamber lights the town tree at Century School Park on the first Friday of December.
A decorated trolley carries families around town and between the park and the senior center.
The Verona Fire Department cooks chili at the senior center, raising money for the Badger Prairie Needs Network.
The chamber's reindeer afternoon, formerly called Reindeer Live, mixes live reindeer, crafts and storytime.
A European style market with chalets, mulled wine, Santa and live reindeer, new to Verona in 2026.
kidfact: At Verona's 2024 tree lighting, Santa skipped the sleigh and rode into the park on a fire truck.
faq: When is the Verona tree lighting?

Verona lights its tree on the first Friday of December as part of the chamber's Hometown Holiday Kick-Off at Century School Park. In 2025 the ceremony began at 5 pm, and in 2026 the kickoff falls on December 4. Check the listing below for current details.
Where is Century School Park in Verona?

Century School Park is at 309 West Verona Avenue in Verona. It opened as a new park in 2024 and now hosts the tree lighting and, in 2026, the Christkindlmarket. The Holiday Express Trolley connects it with the Verona Senior Center on kickoff night.
Can children see live reindeer in Verona?

Yes. The Verona Area Chamber of Commerce's Santa's Workshop brings live reindeer, and the Christkindlmarket also lists live reindeer alongside Santa and Mrs. Claus. See the event listings for each date and ticket details.
Is there a Christmas market in Verona?

Yes. Christkindlmarket moves to Century School Park in Verona in December 2026. It began in Paoli in 2023 with local makers and artists, and it offers shopping chalets, mulled wine and visits with Santa. Tickets and hours are on the market's own page.

The Verona Area Chamber of Commerce says Santa's Workshop builds on the tradition of Reindeer Live, keeping familiar favorites and adding more activities. Past reindeer afternoons took place at Sugar Creek Elementary School.
